politics.headline: Ukraine's air-defense challenge remains a major strategic problem
politics.body: Russia launched another large combined missile-and-drone attack against Ukraine. Ukrainian forces intercepted many incoming systems, but ballistic missiles remain particularly difficult to defeat.

politics.body: Taiwan's cabinet proposed an 18% increase in 2027 defense spending, emphasizing missiles, drones, submarines and other asymmetric capabilities.

politics.body: Auburn's Applied Research Institute in Cummings Research Park is working on areas including space-radiation effects and advanced manufacturing.

science.headline: Machine learning connects architected-material geometry to thermo-mechanical properties
science.body: New work on triply periodic minimal-surface architected materials uses geometric descriptors to predict properties including stiffness, strength and thermal conductivity. The engineering question is whether this can accelerate geometry optimization without replacing physical understanding.

science.headline: Si₃N₄ fiber composites are being investigated for high-temperature wave-transparent structures
science.body: Research into silicon-nitride fiber-reinforced composites targets demanding combinations of mechanical performance, thermal stability and electromagnetic transparency.

science.headline: High-order virtual-element methods target difficult variable-stiffness plate problems

exploration.body: Astronauts are preparing to finish replacing a space-to-ground communications antenna while continuing research aboard the station, including work related to space manufacturing.

exploration.headline: Swift servicing mission changes objectives after spacecraft issue
exploration.body: A commercial mission intended to boost NASA's Swift Observatory changed plans after an attitude-control problem. The spacecraft will instead demonstrate rendezvous and proximity operations.

puzzle.title: The Broken Beam
puzzle.question: A simply supported 24-inch beam has a 1,200-lb center load, a 2 × 1-inch rectangular section, and a material yield strength of 60 ksi. The nominal maximum bending stress is 54 ksi, yet the beam fails at the center. What is the most important thing to establish before concluding that the material simply failed because the applied stress exceeded its strength?
puzzle.answer: Establish whether the actual local stress state and actual geometry match the nominal calculation. Check the real cross section, load alignment, stress concentrations, defects, residual stress, material orientation, shear effects and the actual failure mode. A nominal stress below yield does not prove that the local failure-driving stress was below the material's relevant strength.
